title: Homophonic search: synthetic recovery controls
question: Does the recovered P6 homophonic partition search recover and detect these three known synthetic inputs?
reader_question: Can this search recover the known hidden classes?
summary: Three synthetic controls missed complete recovery and both source detection gates. No manuscript target was scored.
finding: Complete class-stream recovery was 0/3. Source many-to-one row-max alignment was 56.9–61.9%, versus 36.7–56.3% one-to-one alignment. Source Part-C z was 1.19–1.89 and held-out z was 0.21–1.94; all failed the strict z > 3 gates. Equal-budget shuffled fits matched or exceeded the planted fit in 7/8, 2/8 and 1/8 cases.
reader_finding: The search did not completely recover any of three known synthetic inputs, and all three missed both detection gates.
reader_limit: Controls only: no manuscript target was scored. The selected key and puzzle texts are not independent English validation or a verified historical replay.
limitations: Three fixed plants test this recovered implementation only. Main-tree text inputs were explicitly selected because recovered inputs are absent; mixed puzzle/key material is not independent English prose. The source row-max statistic is not exact recovery, and source Part-C budgets differ. Eight matched shuffled fits per plant do not estimate a general false-positive rate. The 72 source Part-C null-fit witnesses and three single-shuffle maps were not retained; their moments remain producer summaries. No original D-03 family closure or LP2 target exclusion follows.
next_steps: Review the recovered implementation and freeze a control-validated search with matched selection budgets and genuinely held-out inputs before manuscript testing.

scope.representation: Three source-design synthetic 29-symbol homophonic streams derived from explicitly selected main-tree puzzle/key text; no manuscript target.
scope.procedure: AST-extract unchanged recovered P6 functions; generate three planted class streams; run frozen annealing fits and source gates, plus equal-budget shuffled comparisons; independently reconstruct and rescore retained witnesses.
scope.parameters: Length 12,956 each; seeds 11/23/37; classes 12/12/18; suppression 0/0.9/0.9. Fits 4,000 iterations × 4 restarts. Source Part-C 24 null fits × 1 restart; held-out 500 shuffles per case; added 8 equal-budget null fits × 4 restarts per case. Trigram models for k=12, bigrams for k=18.
scope.exclusions: No manuscript target, historical replay, multilingual D-03 grid, whole-family exclusion, independent English validation, or general false-positive-rate estimate.

review.reviewer: Fresh portable replay plus independent reconstruction and retained-witness scoring; human review pending

reproduction.environment: Python 3.12.10, NumPy 2.5.4. Prepare external d03-inputs with the bundled prepare_external_inputs.py using the exact four pinned paths/hashes in external-input-contract.json. No texts or packages are installed automatically. Choose a new replay directory; see article and PORTABILITY.md.

visuals.caption: All three synthetic controls missed both source z > 3 detection gates; complete recovery was zero of three. These are repeated evaluations of the same plants.

materials.summary: Complete three-plant control outputs, frozen plan, source code and retained shuffled-fit witnesses.
materials.reuse: Reconstruct and rescore these controls, or replay with externally prepared exact texts.
materials.limits: No manuscript targets. Source unequal-budget null moments lack individual fit witnesses; texts are external and not independent prose.
